method: V12 compass set with corrected GPT Image 2 horizontal left and right endpoints plus a regenerated right-to-bottom-right midpoint, then border-connected magenta alpha extraction and lossless WebP export

constraints.uniformResize: left and right sources: 1280x1280 to 1254x1254; regenerated right-to-bottom-right midpoint: uniform 2.9% pre-key scale followed by canvas alignment and 1280x1280 to 1254x1254 normalization

inputs: prior V13 left endpoint: edit target for framing, scale, crop, shoulders, wardrobe, and horizontal pose correction
top-left.webp: fixed hair-only reference for crown height, width, side fullness, texture, and identity
center.webp: supporting identity, lighting, and wardrobe reference
prior V13 right endpoint: edit target for horizontal pose, expression, wardrobe, lighting, and framing
bottom-right.webp: fixed scale, camera-distance, shoulder-proportion, and placement reference only
top-right.webp: fixed hair-only reference for crown height, width, side fullness, texture, and identity
center.webp: supporting identity, lighting, and wardrobe reference

rebuiltTransition.alignment: uniformly resized generated 1280x1280 source to 1317x1317, then extracted a 1280x1280 canvas at x=22, y=16 before alpha extraction
inputs: corrected right endpoint source: authoritative start pose, identity, scale, hair, wardrobe, lighting, and framing
bottom-right.webp: authoritative end pose, scale, placement, hair, wardrobe, lighting, and framing
center.webp: supporting identity and wardrobe reference
